personal.title: You are posting in your personal space
personal.body: This entry belongs to you, not to your office. Your colleagues neither see nor manage it — and it stays yours even if you change office.
personal.brokered: To post under a client mandate, use Mandates inside your office space.

door.label: I am looking
door.hint: Tell us what you are looking for — and we will tell you what exists nearby, even when nothing matches.

list.title: My requests
list.lead: Each request is a standing order: it waits for the match — and tells you what exists nearby while it waits.
list.emptyHint: A request is worth making even when nothing matches today: you learn what exists nearby, what blocks it, and how many others are looking for the same.
list.error: Your requests could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.

affirm.done: Recorded. Your request counts in the anonymous total again.
affirm.failed: The confirmation was not recorded. Please try again.
affirm.stale: Over {days} days without confirmation — it does not count in the anonymous total.
affirm.staleWhy: The request stays yours forever. What goes stale is our claim to third parties that someone is looking — and it comes back with one click.

lifecycle.label: Status
lifecycle.withdrawNote: Withdrawing deletes nothing — the request stays in your list and stops looking.
lifecycle.failed: The status did not change. Please try again.

form.title: What are you looking for?
form.lead: We only ask what the matching needs. Anything you leave empty means “not a condition” — not “zero”.
form.failed: The request was not saved. Please try again shortly.
form.notEditableHere: This request defines its area in a way this screen does not yet compose ({placeKind}). Its remaining details are shown normally.

seeks.help: Pick at least one. Without it, the request would match everything.
seeks.exchange: I am looking for land for a build-to-share deal
seeks.leaseShort: I am looking for a place to stay for a few nights

place.anywhere: Anywhere — I care about what, not where
place.queryPlaceholder: City, area, or street with number
place.notFound: We could not locate that area. Try a city, or a street with a number.
place.failed: The lookup did not respond. Please try again shortly.

frontage.help: Draw the stretch of street you care about on the map, pick a side, and say how deep it still counts as “on the street”.
frontage.gestureAxis: Tap the start and end of the stretch on the map
frontage.gestureSide: Now tap the side you care about
frontage.sideHelp: A street can bend — “north” or “south” does not stay fixed along its length. The direction you drew it in is a fixed reference, which is why we say left/right relative to that.
frontage.depthHelp: The further back from the street frontage, the less it counts as “on the street”. This depth sets that limit.

timing.help: No property portal asks this. We know what is being built — so we can meet supply that does not exist yet.
timing.wheneverHint: The request never expires. We will only ask you to confirm that you are still looking.

features.priceHelp: The amount is judged against the price that applies to each listing — sale or rent.
features.floorHelp: 0 is the ground floor — a real value, not “any”.

proximity.help: Points of interest are not sourced yet. Your requirement is recorded now and will be judged as soon as the measurements exist.

lifeContext.help: Optional. It is never judged in the matching — it only fills the blanks below, and you can change all of them.
lifeContext.filled: {count, plural, one {# field was filled in} other {# fields were filled in}} — change them freely.
lifeContext.filledNone: Nothing changed: you had already filled them in.

invariant.heading: The request cannot be saved yet:
invariant.seeks-empty: Pick at least one kind of transaction — otherwise the request matches everything.
invariant.seeks-duplicated: The same kind of transaction was declared twice.
invariant.window-inverted: The “to” date is before the “from” date.
invariant.range-inverted: A range has its lower bound above its upper bound.
invariant.radius-not-positive: The radius must be greater than zero.
invariant.proximity-not-positive: A neighbourhood distance is zero or negative.
invariant.proximity-duplicated: The same kind of neighbourhood requirement was declared twice.
invariant.axis-degenerate: The frontage axis has no direction — all its points are the same, so there is no “left” or “right”. Draw it again, with a start and an end at different points.
invariant.depth-not-positive: The depth must be greater than zero.

formBlocker.place-unresolved: Press “Locate” so the area resolves to a point on the map.
formBlocker.window-incomplete: Fill in both ends of the period.
formBlocker.place-not-identified: Show on the map which building or plot you mean.
formBlocker.area-not-drawn: Draw the area — at least three vertices.
formBlocker.frontage-axis-missing: Draw the street axis on the map — at least two points.

answer.heading: What exists today
answer.matched: {count, plural, one {# listing matches} other {# listings match}}.
answer.nothingToJudge: There is no published listing to judge yet. Your request is waiting — and it will meet the first one that matches.
answer.nearButUnreachable: There {count, plural, one {is # listing close} other {are # listings close}} to your request, but none within a distance worth suggesting.
answer.noMatch: {count, plural, one {# listing was judged} other {# listings were judged}} and none comes close. The request stays open.
answer.blockedByUnknowns: We cannot judge yet — and that is not the same as “nothing exists”.
answer.blockedByUnknownsWhy: What is missing is our data, not properties.
answer.axesLostHeading: The link above is broader than your request — it ignores:
answer.balanceError: The results ledger does not balance. We do not show a number we cannot stand behind.

axisLost.area-outline: the exact shape of the area

concession.heading: How much is missing
concession.lead: We do not just say “no” — we say how much.
concession.sentence: With {amount} there {count, plural, one {is # listing} other {are # listings}}.

amount.bedrooms-floor: {value, plural, one {# bedroom} other {# bedrooms}} fewer

concession.more: {count, plural, one {# more suggestion} other {# more suggestions}}
concession.unreachable: There are close ones, but the concession needed is large — we are not suggesting it.
concession.multiAxis: {count, plural, one {# listing differs} other {# listings differ}} in two things at once — one change is not enough.
concession.unquantified: {count, plural, one {# listing is close} other {# listings are close}} on an axis that is not measured in an amount.

blocker.heading: What stopped them
blocker.other-place: A different property than the one you asked for
blocker.place-unresolved: We do not know yet which building they belong to
blocker.position-unknown: They have no declared position on the map
blocker.availability-unknown: We do not know yet when they become available
blocker.proximity-unknown: We have not measured what is around them yet
blocker.not-available-then: Not available in the period you asked for
blocker.wrong-side: It is on the other side of the street
blocker.side-unresolved: We do not know yet which side of the street it is on
blocker.outside-frontage: Outside the street stretch you set, or set back deeper than the depth you specified

competition.heading: How many others want the same
competition.count: {count, plural, one {# more person is looking} other {# more people are looking}} for something similar.
competition.none: Nobody else is looking for something similar right now.
competition.hidden: We do not give a number when it describes fewer than {minCount} people.
competition.hiddenWhy: A small number describes individuals. Anonymity is not a hope — it is a threshold.

desktopOnly.title: Creating a request happens on a computer
desktopOnly.body: The form asks four axes at once — place, time, features and neighbourhood. On a narrow screen it would be half a form, and half a request meets nothing.
desktopOnly.what: From here you can view and manage the ones you already have.
desktopOnly.whatAnonymous: You can browse what is already on the market, and post your request when you are at a computer.

detail.notFoundHint: Either it does not exist, or it is not yours. Requests are strictly private.
detail.error: The request could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.

summary.frontage: {side, select, left {Left side} right {Right side} both {Both sides} other {Side}} of the street
summary.frontageNamed: {side, select, left {Left side} right {Right side} both {Both sides} other {Side}} of {street}

space.title: My space
space.signInNeeded: Sign in to see your requests.

interest.heading: Who is looking for something like this
interest.offered: {count, plural, one {# person wants} other {# people want}} exactly this property.
interest.dormant: {count, plural, one {# person is looking} other {# people are looking}} for a property like yours, here.
interest.dormantWhy: You have not listed it for sale or rent, so we compared only what it is and where it is — not price or deal type.
interest.partialWhy: You have not stated a deal type, so the price was compared but not whether you sell or rent.
interest.none: Nobody is looking for something like this right now.
interest.hidden: We do not show a number below {minCount}.
interest.unavailable: We could not read demand right now. Please try again shortly.
interest.privacy: You never learn who they are or exactly what they want — only how many.

door.label: Offer
door.hint: Own a property? List it with a few structured details — and the people looking for it will find it.

list.title: My properties
list.lead: Every listing reaches the public map as soon as it has the basics. Whatever is missing, we tell you here.
list.empty: You have not listed a property yet.
list.emptyHint: A few structured details are needed — type, area, price, location. Without them the property exists in the database and never meets anyone.
list.error: Your properties could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.

workspaceCta.title: Working professionally?
workspaceCta.body: Create your office workspace — projects, contacts and files, kept separate from your own.

mandates.title: Office mandates
mandates.lead: Every property you listed on behalf of a client, and what became of their approval. The ones waiting on you come first.
mandates.error: The mandates could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
mandates.empty: You have not yet listed a property on behalf of a client.
mandates.emptyHint: When you list a client property we send them a link to approve it. Here you will see who answered, who never even opened the message, and which mandate is close to expiring.
mandates.truncated: Showing the first {count} mandates. There are more.
mandates.expiresIn: {count, plural, one {Expires in # day} other {Expires in # days}}

standingHint.unannounced-live: The listing is already on the map, but the owner has never received a notice. Send it to them.
standingHint.never-notified: No message has gone out to the owner. Press “Resend” — the reason will be recorded.
standingHint.link-revoked: You revoked the link, so the client can no longer answer. Send a new one if you want them to continue.
standingHint.expiring-soon: The agreement is ending. Renewal needs a new written mandate, not an extension.
standingHint.awaiting-decision: They opened the link and have not decided yet. A phone call usually does it.
standingHint.awaiting-view: The message was sent and has not been opened. Check whether it landed in spam.
standingHint.declined: The listing is not published. The owner can change their mind from the same link.
standingHint.expired: The mandate ended and the listing came off the map. A new agreement is needed.
standingHint.expired-unanswered: The deadline passed without the owner ever answering.
standingHint.live: All good. The listing is on the map.

neverNotifiedHint.no-address: The contact has no email address, so there is nowhere to send the link. Add one on their card and send again.
neverNotifiedHint.failed: The contact details are fine — the message never entered the send queue. Press “Resend”.

actionDone.revoke: The link was revoked. The client can no longer answer.

reject.not-brokered: This listing was not made on behalf of a client.
reject.expired: The mandate has expired. A new agreement is needed.
reject.not-pending: Revoking is only possible while the owner answer is pending.
reject.no-address: The contact has no email address. Add one on their record and try again.
reject.write-failed: It did not go through. Please try again shortly.
reject.network: No answer received. Check your connection and try again.

presenceDone.withdraw: The listing is off the map. The mandate is unchanged.
presenceDone.restore: The listing is back on the map.

desktopOnly.title: Listing a property is done on a computer
desktopOnly.body: The form asks about type, area, location and what you want to do with the property, all together. On a narrow screen it would be half a form — and a property without fields is found by no one.
desktopOnly.what: From here you can view and manage what you have already listed.
desktopOnly.whatAnonymous: You can browse what is already on the market, and list your property when you are at a computer.

offerKind.label: What do you want to do with the property?
offerKind.help: You can pick more than one — for example both for sale and for short stays.

placeAnswer.label: Where is it?
placeAnswer.help: Location is not mandatory. Without it, though, the property does not appear on the map — only in the list.
placeAnswer.declined: I would rather not say for now

form.title: List a property
form.lead: We only ask what is needed for people to find you. Whatever we can compute, we do not ask.
form.failed: The listing was not saved. Please try again.
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. 92 sqm apartment in the centre
form.priceHelp: Without a price the listing is not published — that is the rule of every serious marketplace.
form.placeNotFound: No such address was found. Try writing it differently.
form.placeFailed: Locating did not complete. Please try again shortly.
form.placeDeclinedNote: The property will appear in the list marked as having no stated location.
form.placeLinkHelp: Optional. If you point at it, your listing meets the people searching for THIS building — not just the area.
form.placeRefine: A more specific address gives a more precise location. You can also point at the building on the map below.

placeAccuracyNote.exact: The building. The map marker points exactly there.
placeAccuracyNote.interpolated: The street — not the building. The circle shows the range.
placeAccuracyNote.approximate: The area — not the address. The circle shows the range.
placeAccuracyNote.center: Only the settlement. The address was not found; the circle shows how large the uncertainty is.

placeHouseNumber.contradicted: You entered "{number}", the map found "{resolved}". Check the number.
placeHouseNumber.unconfirmed: Number "{number}" was recorded, but the map data does not confirm it — the position shows the street.

draftMemory.title: We restored your draft
draftMemory.help: We found the listing you had started in this browser. If it is not yours, start over.

media.label: Photos and floor plans
media.help: Upload whatever you have — photos, a floor plan, a PDF. Not mandatory.
media.landHelp: Upload whatever you have — photos, a survey plan, a PDF. Not mandatory.
media.failed: {fileName} was not uploaded. Please try again.
media.accountRequired: Files upload once you sign in. Fill in the rest now — the account is asked for at the end.
media.empty: You have not uploaded any files.
media.publishedCount: {published} of {max} are published. The first one is the card image.
media.privateNote: Your files are private. Only the ones you select are published in the listing, and only after their metadata (location, device, capture time) has been stripped.

invariant.heading: The listing is not saved yet:
invariant.no-live-offer: Choose what you want to do with the property — sale, rent, land-for-flats exchange or short-term rental.
invariant.duplicate-offer-kind: The same kind of offer was declared twice.
invariant.offer-amount-missing: An offer is missing its amount: price for sale, rent for renting, share for exchange, price per night for short-term rental.
invariant.exchange-percentage-out-of-range: The landowner share must be between 1 and 100.
invariant.short-lease-min-nights-invalid: Minimum nights must be at least 1. Leave the field empty if you do not want a limit.
invariant.short-lease-max-guests-invalid: Maximum guests must be at least 1. Leave the field empty if you do not want a limit.
invariant.area-not-positive: Enter an area greater than zero.
invariant.exchange-requires-land: An exchange (antiparochi) applies only to land. Choose «Plot» or «Parcel» as the property type, or remove the exchange.
invariant.short-lease-requires-dwelling: Short-term rental applies to dwellings — it is priced per night and counts guests. Pick a residential property type, or remove the short-term rental.
invariant.mandate-client-missing: The mandate does not name a client.
invariant.mandate-expiry-invalid: The expiry date cannot be read.
invariant.mandate-expiry-past: The expiry date is in the past.
invariant.mandate-attestation-not-confirmed: The mandate attestation was not recorded correctly.
invariant.mandate-term-exceeds-statute: The term exceeds the statutory maximum for this type of mandate.
invariant.mandate-agreement-invalid: No valid type of mandate has been declared.
invariant.mandate-scope-empty: The mandate does not say which transaction it covers. Choose sale, letting or exchange.
invariant.mandate-start-invalid: The start date is unreadable or falls after the expiry.
invariant.mandate-term-empty: The mandate starts and expires at the same moment, so it covers no days. Give it a longer term.
invariant.mandate-conflicts-existing: An existing mandate does not allow this agreement.
invariant.mandate-conflict-undetermined: We could not check the existing mandates. Please try again.

formBlocker.place-unresolved: Press Locate so the address resolves to a point on the map.
formBlocker.mandate-client-unset: Choose the client you are listing for.
formBlocker.mandate-expiry-unset: State the date the mandate runs until.
formBlocker.mandate-term-illegal: The term exceeds the statutory maximum. Choose an earlier end date or a different type of mandate.
formBlocker.account-required: Sign in or create an account so your listing can be saved.

lifecycle.label: Status
lifecycle.withdrawNote: Withdrawing deletes nothing — the listing leaves the public map and stays in your list.
lifecycle.failed: The status did not change. Please try again.

publish.published: The listing is on the public map.
publish.withdrawn: The listing is not on the public map.
publish.failed: Saved, but the public listing was not updated. Save it again to retry.

detail.absent: This property does not exist — or it is not yours.
detail.error: The property could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.

mandate.title: The mandate on this property
mandate.lead: The terms in force, as you agreed them. A mandate does not stop you from managing your own listing.
mandate.expiresIn: {count, plural, one {expires in # day} other {expires in # days}}
mandate.contactNote: Changes to the terms are made in writing with the agency. You have their contact details from your own agreement.

standing.awaiting-view: An agency claims a mandate you have not confirmed
standing.expired-unanswered: Expired without an answer from you

consent.title: Mandate approval
consent.introWithAgency: The agency “{agency}” is asking to market your property.
consent.introNoAgency: A real-estate agency is asking to market your property.
consent.explain: If you agree, the listing will be published marked as coming from an agency. If not, it will not be published.
consent.decline: No, I do not grant it
consent.approvedBody: Thank you. The listing can now be published.
consent.declinedBody: The listing will not be published.
consent.changeMind: You can change your answer at any time, from the same link.
consent.currentlyApproved: You have already granted the mandate.

reason.link-expired: This link has expired. Ask the agency for a new one.
reason.not-brokered: This listing has no agency mandate.
reason.client-mismatch: This link does not match this mandate.
reason.superseded: There is a newer message from the agency. Please use the most recent link.
reason.write-failed: Your answer was not recorded. Please try again.
reason.service-unavailable: We cannot check this link right now. There is nothing wrong with your link - please try again shortly, or let the agency know.

office.newSubtitle: You are listing a client's property. The owner will be notified.
office.clientHint: The property owner, as held in your contacts.
office.clientsNone: No contacts found. Add the client to your Contacts first.
office.clientsFailed: Contacts could not be loaded - that is not the same as having none. Refresh the page.
office.untilHint: Maximum term {months} months for this type of mandate — {authority}.
office.agreementHint: Determines what the owner may do alone, how many agencies may hold a mandate, and how long it may run.

agreementOptions.exclusive-agency: Exclusive agency, owner retains the right

agreementHints.exclusive-agency: You are the only agent, but the owner may sell on their own without owing a fee.
agreementHints.exclusive-right-to-sell: You are owed a fee whoever finds the buyer, including the owner.
agreementHints.open: The owner may also instruct other agencies. A fee is owed only to whoever produces the result.

office.commissionHint: Freely negotiable. The owner sees it before approving, and it never appears on the public listing.
office.viaOwnerConsentHint: We send them a link. The listing goes live once they answer yes.
office.viaAgencyAttestationHint: The listing goes live at once. The owner is notified and can stop it.

notify.sent: A notice was sent to the owner ({to}).
notify.no-address: The contact has no email — the owner was NOT notified.
notify.failed: The notice to the owner was not sent.

showcase.title: Your agency's storefront
showcase.lead: Say that you want to be found. Until you do, your agency appears nowhere — and that is the correct starting point.
showcase.aliasHint: The link you hand out on a card, a sign or a referral. It is your workspace alias and is not changed from here.
showcase.nameHint: How you want people to see you. It is written explicitly for publication — nothing is copied automatically from your company record.
showcase.gemiHint: The proof that the agency exists and is licensed. Without it the directory becomes names that merely claim to be agents.
showcase.placeHint: Used only for neutral geographic ordering. There is no ranking, rating or paid placement.
showcase.noChannel: The storefront publishes no phone number and no email. The only action it offers is a written request with a date and terms — as the law requires for a brokerage contract.
showcase.withdrawHint: Withdrawing erases the storefront. Your listings are not affected.
showcase.notAllowed: The agency directory requires an approved brokerage capacity.
showcase.failed: The action did not complete. Please try again.

rejection.agency-profile-alias-missing: Your workspace does not have an address yet.
rejection.agency-profile-name-missing: Write the business name people will see.
rejection.agency-profile-occupation-missing: Declare at least one occupation — without it the showcase says nothing.
rejection.agency-profile-registration-missing: This occupation requires a registry number to appear in the directory.
rejection.agency-profile-chapter-missing: Also state the chapter that issued the number — a bare number cannot be verified.

showcase.occupationHint: Pick from the European ESCO classification — that is how people find you by the right criteria.
showcase.occupationPlaceholder: e.g. plumber, lawyer, real estate agent
showcase.occupationUnclassified: Pick an occupation from the list. Free text does not appear in the directory filters.
showcase.registryHint: The number as issued by the authority. You declare it — we have not checked it.
showcase.chapterHint: Which chapter issued the number. Without it, the number cannot be verified by anyone.
showcase.registryNone: No authority keeps a registry for this occupation. Nothing is missing from your showcase.
showcase.registryUnexamined: We have not examined whether a registry exists for this occupation.
showcase.occupationUnknown: This occupation was not found in the classification. Please pick again from the list.
showcase.temporarilyUnavailable: We could not complete this right now. Try again — do not change anything.
showcase.placeNotFound: The place you declared was not found. Please pick it again on the map.

directory.title: Professionals
directory.lead: Professionals who chose, themselves, to be found here. The nearest come first — and those almost equally close, equally. If we do not know where you are, everyone is equal: no ranking, no rating, no paid placement.
directory.empty: Nobody has published a showcase yet.
directory.emptyHint: When a professional declares they want to be found, they will appear here.
directory.emptyAfterFilterHint: Try another speciality or a wider radius — or clear the filters to see everyone.
directory.failed: We could not load the directory. Please try again shortly.
directory.occupationSearchEmpty: No specialty matches what you typed
directory.occupationScopeHint: This list shows the {count, plural, one {# specialty professionals have declared} other {# specialties professionals have declared}} so far — not every occupation. If what you are looking for is missing, nobody has registered for it yet.

claim.declared: Self-declared. We have not checked it.

note.registryExistsUndeclared: A register is kept for this profession ({authority}). This showcase does not state a number.
note.registryAbsentByNature: No authority keeps a register for this profession. Nothing is missing from this showcase.
note.registryUnexamined: We have not examined whether a register is kept for this profession.
note.authorityMismatch: The number stated belongs to a different authority than the one keeping the register for this showcase's profession ({expected}).
note.registryAbsentYetDeclared: We know of no register for this showcase's profession. The number was stated by the professional.
note.classificationUnreadable: We could not read the classification of this profession.

profile.absentTitle: There is no showcase at this address
profile.absentLead: This link does not match a published agency. It may not exist, or it may no longer be published.
profile.failedTitle: We could not show this agency
profile.failedLead: Something blocked the read. This does not mean the agency is gone — please try again shortly.
profile.gemiHint: The General Commercial Registry number is the proof that the agency exists and is licensed.
profile.requestCta: Ask them to take on your property
profile.requestHint: A written request with a date and terms will be drawn up. Nothing of yours is sent until the agency accepts.
profile.noChannel: This agency publishes no phone number and no email — by design. A brokerage contract is concluded in writing, and a phone call leaves no record that protects you.
profile.listingsTitle: What it has on the market right now
profile.listingsEmpty: This agency has no published listings right now.
profile.listingsEmptyHint: That does not mean it is not working — it means it has published nothing here. You can still ask it to take on your own property.
profile.listingsFailed: We could not load its listings. The agency is there — please try again shortly.

request.title: Request an assignment
request.lead: You are drawing up a written request to the agency, with a date and terms. The agency sees the listing and your terms — nothing else. Your name, email and tax number reach it only if it accepts.
request.listingHint: Only properties {criteria} are shown. If one is missing, it has been withdrawn — restore it first.
request.listingsEmpty: You have no property that can be assigned right now.
request.agreementHint: The type determines the lawful maximum duration.
request.compensationHint: 2% is the customary commission in the Greek market, not a legal limit. The commission is freely negotiable.
request.expiresHint: The day you state counts in full.
request.failed: We could not send the request. Please try again shortly — nothing needs to change.
request.request-listing-unset: Choose which property you want the agency to take on.
request.request-expiry-unset: State how long the mandate will be valid.
request.request-expiry-past: The expiry date is already in the past. Choose a day in the future.
request.request-term-illegal: The duration exceeds the lawful maximum for this type of agreement.
request.request-compensation-invalid: State a commission greater than zero.
request.tax-identity-required: Your tax ID is missing. Enter it in this form — Greek law (art. 200 §2, L.4072/2012) requires it for the mandate agreement, and the agency sees it only after it accepts your request.
request.tax-identity-unsaved: The number in the tax ID field was not saved — the previous one would be sent. Correct it, or clear the field to restore it.
request.listing-absent: This listing was not found among yours.
request.listing-not-live: The listing is withdrawn, so the agency has nothing to see. Restore it first.
request.listing-already-brokered: This listing is already assigned to an agency.
request.agency-absent: This agency was not found. It may no longer be published.
request.request-already-pending: You have already sent this agency a request for this property, with different terms. Withdraw it first — we do not change a document the agent may already be reading.
request.request-declined-final: This agency has given a final refusal for this listing. You can approach another agency.
request.unverified: We could not ask right now. This does not mean anything is wrong — please try again shortly, without changing anything.
request.sentLead: The agency sees the listing and your terms. It will learn who you are only if it accepts.
request.alreadySentTitle: The request had already been sent
request.alreadySentLead: You had already sent exactly this request. No second one was created — the agency sees one.
request.occupancyHeld: A mandate already exists. Your terms stand alongside it.
request.occupancyBlocked: Your terms cannot stand alongside what is already in force.
request.occupancyUndetermined: We could not check what is in force. Send it — the agency will judge.
request.occupancyReasonExisting: Holds an exclusive right until then.
request.occupancyReasonCandidate: You ask for an exclusive while open listings apply.
request.occupancyNoWait: Waiting will not help. Ask for an open listing, or withdraw the existing ones.
request.scopeHint: Binds only what you select. An exclusive to sell does not block letting elsewhere.
request.startsHint: May be a future date — e.g. after another mandate expires.
request.request-start-after-expiry: It ends before it starts. Correct the start or the end.
request.listing-conflicting-mandate: Another agency holds a right over a transaction you asked for. See above until when.
request.identity-incomplete: Your profile is incomplete: a brokerage mandate needs both your full name and your VAT number. Fill them in on your profile and send the request again — the terms you entered are not lost.

inbox.title: Incoming mandate requests
inbox.lead: Owners asking you to take on their listing. You see the property and the terms — not the person.
inbox.emptyHint: When an owner asks you to take on their listing, it will appear here.
inbox.failed: Incoming requests could not be loaded.
inbox.withoutListing: {count} requests refer to listings that were withdrawn and are not shown.
inbox.truncated: Showing the first requests. Answer these to see the rest.
inbox.decidingFailed: The decision was not recorded. Please try again.
inbox.anonymity: The owner's details reach you only if you accept.

hints.actionable: The owner is waiting. The proposal stands until the date it states.
hints.lapsed: The mandate they propose has already expired, so it cannot be accepted. The owner can send a new proposal.
hints.decided: The history of your answers for these listings.

decisionHints.accepted: You take on the listing under these terms. A client record is created and the mandate becomes active immediately.
decisionHints.declined-revisable: The owner may send you another request, with any terms — even the same ones.
decisionHints.declined-final: They will not be able to send another request for this listing. If they withdraw and republish it, they can.

decided.declined-revisable: You asked for a new proposal

refusals.request-not-pending: Someone got there first — the request has already been decided.
refusals.request-lapsed: The proposal has expired and can no longer be decided.
refusals.identity-incomplete: The owner has not filled in their identity details (full name or VAT number), and no brokerage contract can be drawn up without them. The request STAYS open: contact them and press Accept again.
refusals.mandate-invalid: The proposed terms are not lawful for this type of mandate.

first.ctaHint: You send your details. You do not get theirs.
first.dialogLead: A dated record is written. They see only what you leave here — nothing else, not what you can afford.
first.channelHint: Leave at least one way to reply. You choose which.
first.openedLead: Your details are now on their list. You can withdraw the contact whenever you want.
first.alreadyOpenLead: The contact was already open. Nothing was sent twice and you did not take a second slot.
first.failed: We could not send your details. Please try again shortly.
first.unavailable: We could not ask right now. Try again shortly — nothing was lost.
first.target-absent: We could not find it. The link may be old.
first.target-not-live: This listing is no longer on the market — it was withdrawn or its mandate expired.
first.contact-own-target: This is yours. No need to reach out to yourself.
first.capacity-full: You have {capacity} open contacts, which is the maximum. Close one of the open ones to reach out to someone else.
first.demand-absent: The request you refer to was not found among yours.
first.contact-no-name: Write what they should call you.
first.contact-no-channel: Leave an email or a phone — otherwise they have no way to reply.
first.contact-withdrawal-timeless: Something went wrong with the record. Please try again.
first.contact-foreign-id: Something went wrong with the record. Please try again.
first.contact-reason-without-demand: Something went wrong with the record. Please try again.
first.contact-name-unset: Write what they should call you — this is the name they will see.
first.contact-channel-unset: Leave an email or a phone. Either one is enough.
first.contact-email-malformed: The email needs the form name@example.com
first.contact-phone-malformed: The phone needs 10 digits (e.g. 6912345678) or international form (+30…).
first.errorSummaryTitle: Not sent — please fix the following

mine.withdrawAbsent: This contact was not found among yours.
